entries.text:
SEC. 1299S. RULE OF CONSTRUCTION 
                            RELATING TO USE OF MILITARY FORCE.

    Nothing in this Act or any amendment made by this Act may be 
construed to authorize the use of military force.

[[Page 134 STAT. 4029]]
